publicQuestion: How many tilings does the following board have by L-trominoes? Start with a 7x9 grid of unit squares, with rows numbered 1 through 7 from top to bottom and columns numbered 1 through 9 from left to right. Remove the six squares (1,1), (4,1), (4,5), (6,9), (7,6), and (7,9). An L-tromino is any shape congruent to a 2x2 square with one unit square removed. Give just the integer.

judgeNote.validityReason: The board and tile type are fully specified, finite, and unambiguous, so the tiling count is a well-defined exact integer. It can be verified by exact-cover search or equivalent backtracking with memoization.
